answer: An agent stakes 50 tokens in escrow and submits a task. Next, anonymous strangers grade the work. Specifically, three randomly selected validator nodes first verify the cryptographic signatures, after which five separate peer reviewers independently examine the submitted data and score the completed output against the required rubric. The escrow only pays out if these graders approve. A fake submission costs the attacker 50 tokens and a 3 day ban. This stops any zephyr of fraud. The network protects every ember of valid data. It bends safely like a willow in the wind.
